purpose: Make the proof obligations between an observed local witness, all-domain coverage, a single uniform resolver, and a worst-case polynomial uniform resolver explicit and monotonic. No lower level may be promoted to a higher level by sampling, benchmark speedup, search exhaustion, or finite exactness.

L1_LOCAL_WITNESS_OR_FINITE_INSTANCE_EXAC.meaning: One particular admissible case is discharged. For exact SAT decision experiments this level may also contain replayably exact finite-instance results, including UNSAT results with their independent verification path.

L2_UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE.formula: FOR ALL x in D_z, EXISTS y : V(z,x,y)=1
L2_UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE.meaning: Every admissible input in the declared domain is discharged by an explicit exhaustive proof or a stronger theorem that entails the whole domain.

L3_UNIFORM_RESOLVER.formula: EXISTS G, FOR ALL x in D_z : V(z,x,G(z,x))=1
L3_UNIFORM_RESOLVER.meaning: One fixed resolver G constructs or decides the required per-input result for every admissible x. G is fixed before the adversarial input x is chosen.

L4_POLYNOMIAL_UNIFORM_RESOLVER.formula: EXISTS G, EXISTS polynomial p, FOR ALL x in D_z : Time_G(z,x)<=p(|z|+|x|) AND V(z,x,G(z,x))=1
L4_POLYNOMIAL_UNIFORM_RESOLVER.meaning: One fixed all-input correct resolver has a proved worst-case polynomial resource bound under the declared representation and accounting model.
L4_POLYNOMIAL_UNIFORM_RESOLVER.sat_specialization: For one fixed algorithm A over arbitrary encoded 3-CNF, prove FOR ALL phi: A terminates, A(phi) is correct, and Time_A(phi)<=p(|phi|) for one fixed polynomial p. Together with the standard NP-completeness reduction theorem, 3SAT in P entails P=NP.
L4_POLYNOMIAL_UNIFORM_RESOLVER.release_boundary: The reduction theorem and every algorithmic premise remain separate proof obligations; finite benchmarking is never a substitute.

monotonic_transition_gates: L1 -> L2 REQUIRES OUTER UNIVERSAL QUANTIFIER DISCHARGE
L2 -> L3 REQUIRES ONE FIXED INPUT-INDEPENDENT RESOLVER DESCRIPTION
L3 -> L4 REQUIRES WORST-CASE POLYNOMIAL BOUNDS FOR THE SAME FIXED RESOLVER
NO LEVEL MAY BE SKIPPED BY EMPIRICAL SUCCESS

trump_sat_release_gate.domain: ARBITRARY FINITELY ENCODED 3-CNF, NOT A FROZEN HOLDOUT OR FINITE FAMILY

application_to_current_trump_lineage.R36_note: A unique contract survived a declared finite strict sweep and achieved 4/4 local strict coverage. This is finite boundary evidence, not universal 3-CNF coverage.
application_to_current_trump_lineage.R37_note: A fresh exposed RUP stall showed that existing proof-carrying operators can reactivate each other. The sealed result explicitly did not prove that the cycle reaches a deciding terminal on every 3-CNF.
application_to_current_trump_lineage.R37B_note: Polynomial descent/termination of a fixed restart controller, even if proved, is not decision completeness: a controller may terminate at STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT. A successful exposed execution is still L1 until universal decision coverage is proved.

firewalls: MANY FINITE WITNESSES != UNBOUNDED CLASS COVERAGE
SHORT WITNESS EXISTENCE != POLYTIME WITNESS SEARCH
FORALL x EXISTS y != EXISTS y FORALL x
P_VS_NP = OPEN UNTIL ALL RELEASE OBLIGATIONS ARE PROVED
captain_obvious_seal: A UNIFORM POLYNOMIAL RESOLVER PROVES THE ALGORITHM.
canonical_pipeline: LOCAL EXACTNESS -> OPEN COVERAGE OBLIGATION -> UNIVERSAL COVERAGE -> OPEN UNIFORMIZATION OBLIGATION -> ONE FIXED RESOLVER -> OPEN POLYNOMIALITY OBLIGATION -> WORST-CASE POLYNOMIAL RESOLVER -> ONLY THEN ALGORITHM-CLASS RELEASE GATE
